editorial:
Imagine wanting to escape your hometown, but your own family keeps pulling you back into the chaos. You get to follow two sisters who have big dreams of getting out of their broken city, but they end up stuck in a wild situation. Their dad is a total womanizer who loves the city, and he manages to drag them into his mess. The vibe is totally laid back and goofy, focusing on a get-rich-quick scheme that spirals out of control. It is the kind of movie where you just sit back and enjoy the madness of a family that cannot stop arguing even when they are fighting a tiny drug lord.

What really makes this work is the weirdness of the villain and the funny chemistry between the siblings. The pacing is pretty quick, though some jokes land better than others. If you love comedies that feel a bit random and lighthearted, you will have a blast. You should definitely try streaming this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors, or maybe rent it on Apple TV if you are just looking for a quick laugh. It is a great pick for a weekend hang with friends where you do not want to think too hard.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the sisters use their clever business plan to outsmart the three-foot-tall drug lord. They manage to secure the money needed to stop the city from going bankrupt, saving their home in the process. After the big showdown, the sisters finally find a balance between their desire to leave and their love for their family. They end up winning the day, leaving the drug lord defeated and the city safe.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky family comedies and weird villains.
